title: The Starpath Quest
premise: Three children are swept into a fantastical realm after discovering an ancient celestial relic hidden beneath an old oak tree. Pursued by dark forces seeking the relic's power, they must journey across enchanted lands to awaken a forgotten guardian and restore balance to the world.
logline: Three ordinary children embark on a mythic quest through a magical realm to protect an ancient celestial relic from a rising darkness.

visualTone.lightingPhilosophy: Golden-hour fantasy naturalism with celestial backlight, magical practical glows, and soft atmospheric diffusion

sets.name: Whispering Oak Glade
sets.description: An ancient forest clearing dominated by a colossal silver-barked oak whose roots form natural archways among glowing wildflowers and moss-covered stones.
sets.atmosphere: Floating pollen, gentle breeze, sparkling dust motes, and birdsong echoing through the trees.
sets.lighting: Warm sunbeams filtering through leaves with emerald reflections and soft golden highlights.

sets.name: Moonbridge Valley
sets.description: A vast valley crossed by a luminous crystal bridge suspended above a mist-filled chasm.
sets.atmosphere: Rolling mist, drifting fireflies, and distant creature calls.
sets.lighting: Moonlit blues contrasted by glowing crystal pathways and silver atmospheric bloom.

sets.name: Celestial Guardian Shrine
sets.description: A mountaintop temple carved into radiant white stone decorated with star maps, celestial carvings, and towering pillars.
sets.atmosphere: High mountain winds, swirling magical particles, and thin clouds passing overhead.
sets.lighting: Brilliant celestial shafts breaking through clouds with radiant blue-white highlights.

characters.name: Lena Hart
characters.actorName: Adventurous young heroine with expressive curiosity
characters.physicalDescription: 12 years old, freckled face, bright green eyes, auburn braided hair, athletic build.
characters.behavioralTraits: Natural leader, inquisitive gaze, confident stride, quick reactions.

characters.name: Owen Reed
characters.physicalDescription: 11 years old, round glasses, dark hair, curious brown eyes, lean frame.
characters.behavioralTraits: Analytical thinker, cautious movement, frequently studies surroundings.

costumes.name: Starbound Explorer Attire
costumes.description: Layered travel tunic with hooded cloak, utility satchel, and celestial embroidery.
costumes.materials: Weathered linen, soft wool, leather straps, silver-thread stitching.
costumes.wearCondition: Freshly equipped with minor signs of woodland travel.

costumes.name: Moonbridge Pathfinder Garb
costumes.description: Lightweight adventuring outfit featuring reinforced boots and glowing rune accents.
costumes.materials: Brushed cotton, enchanted threadwork, polished leather.
costumes.wearCondition: Light dust and signs of recent journeying.

props.name: Celestial Compass
props.description: A golden compass containing a miniature constellation that shifts and rotates inside its crystal face.
props.narrativeSignificance: Guides the children toward the hidden guardian shrine.
props.handlingNote: Held carefully in both hands and consulted whenever choices arise.

props.name: Moonstone Staff
props.description: A carved wooden staff topped with a glowing lunar gemstone.
props.narrativeSignificance: Channels protective magic during dangerous moments.

props.name: Starheart Relic
props.description: A radiant crystal artifact emitting gentle pulses of celestial light.
props.narrativeSignificance: The source of the world's balance and the object sought by dark forces.
props.handlingNote: Carried close to the chest and protected at all costs.

action.roleActions: Kneels beside exposed roots, brushes away soil, and lifts the compass as the other unseen children gather behind.
action.dialogue: Look... I think it's trying to show us something.
action.soundDesign: Birdsong, rustling leaves, magical chimes, distant woodland ambience.

action.roleActions: Walks cautiously across the crystal bridge while comparing symbols on the compass to constellations overhead.
action.dialogue: The stars aren't pointing home... they're pointing forward.
action.roleDialog: Thoughtful realization mixed with nervous excitement.
action.soundDesign: Whistling wind, crystal resonance, distant fantastical creature calls.

action.roleActions: Steps onto the shrine platform and raises the staff as ancient symbols ignite around the temple.
action.dialogue: Guardian of the stars, we need your help!
action.soundDesign: Rising magical energy, stone movements, celestial choir textures.

action.roleActions: Raises the relic skyward as waves of light sweep across the landscape and restore the realm's harmony.
action.dialogue: We found our way because we never stopped believing.
action.soundDesign: Orchestral swell, celestial harmonies, wind gusts, radiant magical crescendo.
